reference_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_products
FROM products
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(category_raw)) IN ('tv & video', 'tv en video', 'tv/video', 'téléviseurs')
alternatives:
WITH spelled AS (  -- one row per product
  SELECT LOWER(TRIM(category_raw)) AS spelling
  FROM products
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_products
FROM spelled
WHERE spelling IN ('tv & video', 'tv en video', 'tv/video', 'téléviseurs')
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE TRIM(LOWER(category_raw)) IN ('tv & video', 'tv en video', 'tv/video', 'téléviseurs')) AS n_products FROM products

other_way.sql:
WITH spelled AS (  -- one row per product
  SELECT LOWER(TRIM(category_raw)) AS spelling
  FROM products
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_products
FROM spelled
WHERE spelling IN ('tv & video', 'tv en video', 'tv/video', 'téléviseurs')
other_way.tradeoff: A named step cleans every value once before the test, which helps when the same cleaning is used twice, but one WHERE is shorter.
